plot_events: An older man fits a compressing capsule around a seated boy's feet and explains its rules.
The man states that only the boy's voice can activate or stop the device.
The boy accepts the ordeal and says he wants to make his father proud.
The capsule tightens around the boy's feet while the man watches for signs of weakness.
The boy endures the pain without calling for it to stop.
A woman protests after the boy withstands more than an ordinary human should.
The man refuses to intervene, insisting that only the boy can stop the machine.
The opened or released device is shown as bloodied and lined with spikes, emphasizing the brutality of the test.

visual_summary: In a clinical or laboratory room, an older man places a domed device over a seated boy's bare feet while a woman watches. The man explains that the capsule will squeeze only the boy's feet and responds only to the boy's voice. He challenges the boy to begin; the boy answers that he wants to make his father proud. The device tightens, the boy silently endures severe pain, and the woman becomes alarmed. When the device is removed, it has transformed into a spiked, bloodied crushing mechanism on the floor. The woman begs the man to stop, but he says only the boy can stop it.
